ha_base_url.title: Home Assistant address
ha_base_url.description: Complete HTTP(S) address, including any port or path prefix. Credentials, query strings and fragments are not supported.

watch_entities.title: Entities to watch
watch_entities.description: Entity IDs separated by commas or newlines. The ordered union with all control targets and dishwasher roles is limited to 32 entities. All control lists together allow 31 controls: one per button/scene, three per media player, two per on/off target, three per cover and one per numeric input. Read selection alone never enables writes.

discovery_prefixes.title: Sensor prefixes to discover
discovery_prefixes.description: Optional read-only sensor. or binary_sensor. prefixes, up to eight, separated by commas or newlines. Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores after the dot, such as sensor.kitchen_; a bare domain prefix matches all its sensors. No wildcards or other domains. Discovery fills unused slots within the 32-entity limit after explicit selections and never enables actions. Leave blank to disable discovery.

dishwasher_running_entity.title: Dishwasher running entity
dishwasher_running_entity.description: Optional single entity ID for a read-only dishwasher state card. Adds this exact entity to watched reads. Matches on/running and off/idle; other states remain literal. No actions are enabled. Leave blank to disable the profile.

dishwasher_duration_entity.title: Dishwasher runtime entity
dishwasher_duration_entity.description: Optional single entity ID reporting runtime since midnight, shown in the running entity card as received without inferred units or a countdown. Requires a different dishwasher running entity. Adds this exact entity to watched reads and never enables actions.

ha_token.title: Home Assistant token
ha_token.description: Required token for this plugin. Reads and explicitly selected actions use its existing Home Assistant account permissions.

action_entities.title: Buttons and scenes to control
action_entities.description: Optional explicit button.* and scene.* IDs, up to 16, separated by commas or newlines. Targets are also watched. Leave blank to disable button and scene actions. These actions can control household devices.

media_player_entities.title: Media players to control
media_player_entities.description: Optional explicit media_player.* IDs, up to four, separated by commas or newlines. Targets are also watched. Offers Play, Pause and Stop. Leave blank to disable media actions.

binary_entities.title: Switches, helpers and lights to control
binary_entities.description: Optional explicit switch.*, input_boolean.* and light.* IDs, up to eight, separated by commas or newlines. Targets are also watched. Offers Turn on and Turn off while Home Assistant reports on or off. Leave blank to disable these actions.

cover_entities.title: Covers to control
cover_entities.description: Optional explicit cover.* IDs, up to four, separated by commas or newlines. Targets are also watched. Offers supported Open, Close and Stop actions while Home Assistant reports a known state. Leave blank to disable cover actions.

number_entities.title: Numbers to control
number_entities.description: Optional explicit number.* IDs, up to four, separated by commas or newlines. Offers a value field and Apply when Home Assistant reports valid numeric bounds and step. Targets are also watched. Leave blank to disable number inputs.

cover_position_entities.title: Cover positions to control
cover_position_entities.description: Optional explicit cover.* IDs, up to four, separated by commas or newlines. Offers a position field and Apply when the cover reports a valid position and supports setting it. Targets are also watched. Leave blank to disable position inputs.
